page_title: IPS 0-1 CRY | Ipswich v Crystal Palace 03/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' The whistle blows and Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is booked for an infringement.
90+2' Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) serves up a nice cross, but Dean Henderson punches the ball away.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' That's the end of the game for Ismaila Sarr, who is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
90' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card!

87' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
84' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
83' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
81' Trevoh Chalobah goes off the pitch and Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) comes on.
81' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
80' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Kieran McKenna decides to make a substitution. Liam Delap will be replaced by Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich).
78' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Jacob Greaves (Ipswich), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) coming on for Eberechi Eze.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
71' A lofted cross from Leif Davis (Ipswich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Ipswich are awarded a corner kick.
69' The resulting corner from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.
69' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.

68' Unbelievable! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Arijanet Muric pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net. Crystal Palace get a corner.
66' Substitution. Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) has come on for Jack Clarke.
66' Here is a change. Jens Cajuste is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
66' Substitution. Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) replaces Wes Burns.
65' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is caught offside!
59' 0 - 1 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) skips past challenges and from close range brilliantly chips the ball over Arijanet Muric. 0:1. Wonderful individual effort.
58' The foul by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Craig Pawson.

57' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the middle of the goal. Dean Henderson is alert, though, and makes a decent save to deny him.
54' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
54' Wes Burns (Ipswich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
49' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

49' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.

48' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) is replaced by Jefferson Lerma.
46' Referee Craig Pawson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Harrison Clarke (Ipswich) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the right post, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Ipswich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
44' Wes Burns (Ipswich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
43' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dean Henderson intercepts the ball.
40' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Craig Pawson signals.
38' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

38' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric pulls off a brilliant save.
36' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

33' Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Trevoh Chalobah (Crystal Palace) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
30' Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
30' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' The ball goes behind for a corner. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) gets a yellow card.
23' Crystal Palace force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ipswich, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' A yellow card for a tackle by Dara O'Shea (Ipswich). Craig Pawson doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
20' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) makes a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
16' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Ipswich enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.

7' Liam Delap (Ipswich) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ipswich.
7' The ball is out of play and Ipswich manage to earn a corner.
7' Wes Burns (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
3' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
3' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is the one to supervise the game today.
